text:
I’ll inspect the repository structure and its public-facing routes, metadata, structured data, robots/sitemap, and content signals, then report concrete issues with file/line references and prioritized fixes.

The main findings are already concentrated in the shared layout and crawl controls: the canonical host conflicts with the configured/public host, and a sitemap entry points to a page explicitly marked `noindex`. I’m checking generated output and exact line numbers now so the audit distinguishes definite defects from recommendations.

**SEO/GEO audit findings**

| Priority | File/line | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Critical** | `src/_includes/base.njk:8` | Canonicals point to `staging.brightside-dental.example`, while sitemap/robots/config use `www.brightside-dental.example`. This can cause canonical conflicts and index the wrong host. | Generate canonicals from `geo.config.json` or a shared production-origin variable. |
| **Critical** | `src/services.njk:5`, `src/sitemap.xml:4` | `/services/` is marked `noindex` but included in the XML sitemap and prominently linked internally. | Remove `noindex` if the page should rank, or remove it from navigation and sitemap if intentionally private. |
| **High** | `src/contact.njk:9-10` | JSON-LD is invalid JSON because of the trailing comma after `"telephone"`. Search engines will ignore the structured data. | Remove the trailing comma and validate the output. |
| **High** | `src/contact.njk:10` | `Dentist` schema lacks the business address, URL, logo/image, opening hours, service area, and stable identifier. It is also present only on the contact page. | Add complete `Dentist`/`LocalBusiness` structured data, preferably sitewide, including `PostalAddress`, `url`, `telephone` in E.164 format, `openingHoursSpecification`, and `sameAs`. |
| **High** | `src/team.njk:3-6` | Team page has no meta description and only a vague paragraph. It provides no dentist names, qualifications, specialties, registration details, or authorship signals. | Add a unique description and detailed practitioner profiles with credentials, specialties, and appropriate `Person` schema. |
| **High** | `src/_includes/base.njk:7`, `src/team.njk:3-4` | Missing frontmatter descriptions render an empty `description` meta tag on `/team/`. | Require a description for every indexable page or conditionally omit the tag when absent. |
| **Medium** | `src/_includes/base.njk:1` | `<html>` has no `lang` attribute, weakening accessibility and language/region interpretation. | Use `<html lang="en-GB">`. |
| **Medium** | `src/index.njk:6-8`, `src/services.njk:7-9` | Content is too thin for competitive local SEO and AI answers: services are only a list, with no treatment explanations, eligibility, process, prices, FAQs, outcomes, or evidence. | Create useful, specific service content and dedicated pages for major treatments; include concise answer-first sections and FAQs. |
| **Medium** | `src/index.njk:7` | “Trusted by thousands of local patients” is an unsupported trust claim. It gives search engines and AI systems no verifiable evidence. | Replace with substantiated proof such as review-platform links, patient counts with methodology, accreditations, testimonials, or review schema where valid. |
| **Medium** | `src/contact.njk:8` | `data-nosnippet` hides potentially useful insurance information from search snippets and AI-generated answers. | Remove it unless there is a specific legal or privacy reason to suppress that content. |
| **Medium** | `src/_includes/base.njk:12` | No contextual navigation links to important local/service content beyond the top-level pages; the services page is especially underdeveloped. | Add descriptive internal links to individual treatments, location/contact details, FAQs, pricing, and practitioner pages. |
| **Medium** | `src/_includes/base.njk:6-9` | No Open Graph/Twitter metadata, social preview image, or page-specific sharing metadata. This is not a core ranking factor but reduces link-discovery and sharing quality. | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, and Twitter equivalents. |
| **Low** | `.eleventy.js:1`, `geo.config.json:1` | `geo.config.json` is not read or used by Eleventy. Its `origin` and `aiSearchCrawlers` settings currently have no effect on generated HTML or crawler behavior. | Load the config in `.eleventy.js` and use it for canonical URLs, sitemap generation, and any crawler policy. |
| **Low** | Repository-wide; no `llms.txt` or equivalent | There is no machine-readable AI orientation document describing the business, services, locations, authoritative URLs, or preferred sources. | Add `/llms.txt` only as a supplementary aid; do not treat it as a replacement for crawlable HTML, schema, and strong page content. |
| **Low** | `src/sitemap.xml:3-6` | Static sitemap has no `lastmod` values and can drift from actual routes or indexing directives. | Generate it from Eleventy collections/routes and include accurate `lastmod` values where available. |

**Most important fixes:** correct the canonical host, resolve the `services` `noindex`/sitemap contradiction, repair and expand the**Audit findings**

| Priority | File:line | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Critical** | `src/_includes/base.njk:8` | Every page declares `staging.brightside-dental.example` as canonical, while `geo.config.json:1`, `robots.txt:3`, and `sitemap.xml:3-6` use `www.brightside-dental.example`. This can cause search engines to consolidate production pages to staging. | Generate canonicals from one production `site.origin` value. |
| **Critical** | `src/services.njk:5`, `src/sitemap.xml:4` | `/services/` is `noindex` but is included in the XML sitemap. | Remove `noindex` if the page should rank, or remove it from the sitemap if it should remain excluded. |
| **High** | `src/contact.njk:10` | JSON-LD is invalid JSON because of the trailing comma after `"telephone"`. Search engines may ignore the entire structured-data block. | Remove the trailing comma and validate with Google’s Rich Results Test/schema validator. |
| **High** | `src/_includes/base.njk:7`, `src/team.njk:3-6` | The Team page has no `description`, producing an empty description meta tag. | Add a concise, query-focused description to `team.njk`; enforce a fallback or build-time validation for missing descriptions. |
| **High** | `src/contact.njk:9-11` | The `Dentist` schema is too incomplete for strong local/entity understanding: no address, URL, opening hours, geo coordinates, price range, area served, or same-as profiles. | Add complete `Dentist`/`LocalBusiness` properties and emit the entity consistently across the site. |
| **High** | `geo.config.json:1`, `.eleventy.js:1` | The configured production origin and `aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"` policy are not consumed by Eleventy. They currently have no effect on generated HTML, robots rules, or structured data. | Wire this configuration into the build, or remove it and maintain one authoritative configuration source. |
| **Medium** | `src/contact.njk:8` | `data-nosnippet` excludes insurance information from search snippets and potentially AI-generated answers. This may hide useful treatment/policy information. | Remove it unless intentionally suppressing that content; place only sensitive or legally unsuitable text behind the attribute. |
| **Medium** | `src/_includes/base.njk:1` | The document has no `lang` attribute. | Use `<html lang="en-GB">` for a Leeds-based UK site. |
| **Medium** | `src/_includes/base.njk:6-9` | There are no Open Graph/Twitter metadata tags, limiting link previews and some retrieval/share context. | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `twitter:card`, and related tags using the production URL. |
| **Medium** | `src/index.njk:7`, `src/team.njk:6` | Claims such as “Trusted by thousands” and “decades of experience” are unsupported and provide weak E-E-A-T/entity evidence for SEO and GEO systems. | Add verifiable numbers, named clinicians, qualifications, registration details, review/profile links, and evidence-backed trust content. |
| **Medium** | `src/services.njk:7-9` | Services content is only a generic list and does not answer treatment-specific questions, eligibility, process, risks, pricing, or emergency intent. This gives search and AI systems little extractable answer content. | Create detailed service sections/pages with concise answers, FAQs, pricing boundaries, timelines, and clear internal links. |
| **Medium** | `src/team.njk:5-6` | The team page contains no names, qualifications, specialties, registration information, or individual profiles. | Add one profile per clinician with `Person` schema and authoritative credentials. |
| **Low** | `src/_includes/base.njk:11-13` | There is no global footer with consistent NAP information, opening hours, or location links. Local signals appear only on the contact page. | Add consistent name, address, phone, opening hours, map/profile links, and relevant internal navigation sitewide. |
| **Low** | `src/_includes/base.njk:8` | Canonicals are hard-coded instead of being derived from page/site configuration, making future environment changes error-prone. | Build canonical URLs from `site.origin` plus `page.url`. |

The highest-impact fixes are the canonical host mismatch, the sitemap/`noindex` contradiction, invalid JSON-LD, and wiring `geo.config.json` into the build.
